grounding.states: Windsor, Ontario, tomorrow Tuesday 13 October: early-morning chance of showers, possibly a thunderstorm, then clearing
grounding.from: The Windsorite gives a 30 percent chance of showers early in the morning with a risk of a thunderstorm, then clearing in the morning

grounding.states: Afternoon sunny, about 29°C at 2 to 5 pm
grounding.from: Environment Canada's hourly forecast has sunny skies from late morning through the afternoon, with 29°C at 2–5 pm
The Windsorite gives a high of 29 with a humidex of 35. Global News has a high of 30

grounding.states: West wind 30 km/h gusting to 50 from mid-afternoon into the evening
grounding.from: Environment Canada's hourly table has west wind of 30 km/h gusting to 50 from mid-afternoon into the evening
The Windsorite lists a UV index of 6 (high)
Its 7-day page says showers are likely overnight, with a risk of a thunderstorm

value.answer: Tomorrow in Windsor starts with a chance of a shower, maybe a thunderstorm, early on, then it clears and turns sunny. The afternoon is around 29°C, feeling like 35 with the humidex. Wind picks up from mid-afternoon, west around 30 km/h with gusts to 50. UV is high (6), so sunscreen. Showers are likely again overnight.
